decision: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST — All seven frozen decision-rule conditions pass (C_STRATIFIED_COVERAGE, C_DECOMPRESSED_DISCRIMINATION, C_DECOMPRESSED_DETERMINISM, C_SINGLE_LAYER_NO_REGRESSION, C_LATENCY, C_NO_ERROR_INFLATION, C_COMPRESSED_BASELINE). The parent audit V1 coverage gap is closed: valid_token × triple_br now observed at 27/180 reps (vs 0/180 in parent), and decompressed hash determinism holds all_same=true across all 27 triple-br observations. Compressed body-only discrimination 0.2781 < 0.3 threshold is expected per frozen spec and confirms decompression is necessary. Independent audit V2 confirms all recomputed metrics match producer exactly. Claim ceiling advances from parent (double-brotli all states + triple-br error states only) to include triple-br for valid_token success body on localhost. C-MEAS-VALID remains EXPERIMENTAL — real CDN infrastructure (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai) remains the sole untested blocker for product readiness.

claim_updates.reason: Decompression-normalization sub-thread advances: iterative decompression (max_depth=5) restores body-only discrimination to 0.5 and hash determinism all_same=true under triple-brotli encoding for ALL auth states including valid_token success body, resolving parent V1 coverage gap (27/180 triple-br valid_token observations vs 0/180). All 7 frozen decision rules pass with audit PASS. However, C-MEAS-VALID remains EXPERIMENTAL because (a) this is localhost mock server only — real CDN infrastructure (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai) is untested; (b) the structural discrimination ceiling of 0.5 is a property of the 3-way error collapse mock design, not a production guarantee; (c) no real OAuth/OIDC production middleware, caching, chunked transfer-encoding, or edge quality diversity has been validated. Claim ceiling bounded to: localhost mock OAuth2 server, synthetic padded JSON/HTML/XML 1KB-100KB, 4 auth states, brotli quality 4-8 cycling, iterative decompression max_depth=5, N=20 per state per condition, seed 44, Python 3.12.14, brotli 1.2.0.

product_action: Advance decompression-normalization to next-phase testing: real CDN infrastructure validation is the blocking gate for product readiness. No code changes required — this is a measurement-only experiment. The validated iterative decompression mechanism (decompress_body loop with max_depth=5) is ready for CDN stress testing.
